plan.major: University Studies: Emphasis in Health and Fitness
plan.notes: Source: Palomar College Program Pathways Mapper (official), University Studies: Emphasis in Health and Fitness Associate in Science Program pathway map, https://programmap.palomar.edu/pathway/university-studies-emphasis-in-health-and-fitness-to-uc-csu/?pt=map&year=2026, retrieved 2026-10-06. Palomar publishes the program total as a range (60–73 units); Choice/variable-unit groups transcribed at the minimum-unit option (choice:true; official ranges in choice_note). total_credits (64) is the exact sum of the minimum-unit pathway. All AA/AS/AA-T/AS-T degrees require 60 units per Palomar; maps represent one possible pathway — see a counselor for a personalized plan.
